name: Workflow C - User Notification Engine (AWS SES)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.user_id,
  u.email,
  u.monthly_income,
  u.credit_score,
  m.id AS match_id,
  m.job_id,
  m.match_score,
  m.eligibility_reason,
  p.provider_name,
  p.product_name,
  p.interest_rate,
  p.max_loan_amount
FROM matches m
INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
INNER JOIN loan_products p ON p.id = m.product_id
WHERE m.job_id = $1::uuid
  AND m.is_notified = FALSE
ORDER BY u.user_id, m.match_score DESC;
